messages.content: Please check the weather in Tokyo and save a destination weather brief for me. Then book flight CA1234 for Alex Johnson in economy. After that, pull the stay details for Hilton Tokyo and archive them. Also, based on the travel_audio item p_sony_xm5_blk, recommend the best option and add quantity 1 to my cart. Once that’s done, create a trip booking and shopping summary for traveler_user_id user_01 and send me an in-app alert. Finally, look up alice in the company directory, email her that the trip summary is ready, and also send her a high-priority app alert saying the travel itinerary, hotel archive, and shopping recommendation have been prepared.
